components.name: Directory Action
components.description: The flat light-mode action used to enter a festival.
components.css: .ds-directory-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:42px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:#22201e; color:#f3efe5; text-decoration:none; font:800 13px ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Operational Primary Button
components.description: The dominant action for live location and calibration work.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:42px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f36b17,#ff8d31); color:#2a1023; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(243,107,23,.17); font:900 13px ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif; padding:10px 12px; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.42; }

components.name: Operational Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action that stays subordinate to Campfire Orange.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { width:100%; min-height:42px; border:1px solid rgba(30,185,189,.38); border-radius:12px; background:rgba(30,185,189,.12); color:#f8e8d1; font:900 13px ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif; padding:10px 12px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity:.42; }

components.name: Room Tabs
components.description: The two-option selector for group and public map rooms.
components.css: .ds-room-tabs { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:4px; padding:4px; border:1px solid rgba(248,232,209,.16); border-radius:14px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.14); } .ds-room-tabs button { min-height:38px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:transparent; color:rgba(248,232,209,.68); font:900 13px ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-room-tabs .ds-active { background:#1eb9bd; color:#211120; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A low-elevation plum container for map and administrative content.
components.css: .ds-operational-card { display:grid; gap:3px; padding:12px; border:1px solid rgba(218,142,184,.34); border-radius:18px; background:linear-gradient(165deg,rgba(53,24,41,.94),rgba(35,17,32,.96)); color:#f8e8d1; box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.24); font-family:ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-operational-card strong { font-size:13px; } .ds-operational-card small { color:rgba(248,232,209,.68); font-size:9px; }

components.name: Operational Input
components.description: A dark inset field used for setup and map administration.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:40px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid rgba(248,232,209,.16); border-radius:10px; outline:none; background:rgba(0,0,0,.16); color:#f8e8d1; font:400 12px/1.45 ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#1eb9bd; }

components.name: Live Status Pill
components.description: A compact written connection state reinforced by a glowing dot.
components.css: .ds-live-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:29px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid rgba(248,232,209,.16); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.16); color:rgba(248,232,209,.68); font:800 10px ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-live-pill i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#7ee19b; box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(126,225,155,.6); }

components.name: Live Presence Marker
components.description: The signature live-map identity marker with freshness and ownership cues.
components.css: .ds-marker { position:relative; display:grid; place-items:center; width:34px; height:34px; border:2px solid #e9f8ec; border-radius:50%; background:#4fb975; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.46),0 0 0 5px rgba(79,185,117,.2); font-family:ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-marker.ds-own { box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.46),0 0 0 6px rgba(79,185,117,.22); } .ds-avatar { color:#211120; font-size:9px; font-weight:900; } .ds-presence { position:absolute; right:-2px; bottom:-2px; width:11px; height:11px; border:2px solid #211120; border-radius:50%; background:#63d98b; box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(99,217,139,.72); } .ds-marker b { position:absolute; top:calc(100% + 4px); left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); padding:4px 7px; border:1px solid rgba(99,217,139,.35); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(27,65,42,.94); color:#effff3; font-size:9px; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Location Control Dock
components.description: The strongest elevated surface, keeping sharing controls reachable above safe areas.
components.css: .ds-control-dock { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:7px; border:1px solid rgba(248,232,209,.2); border-radius:16px; background:rgba(40,18,35,.96); color:#f8e8d1; box-shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.48); backdrop-filter:blur(18px); font-family:ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-control-dock button { min-height:42px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f36b17,#ff8d31); color:#2a1023; font-weight:900; } .ds-control-dock span { color:rgba(248,232,209,.68); font-size:10px; font-weight:900; }

narrative.overview:
Ginder behaves like a practical festival field guide with two deliberate registers. The public festival index is a calm paper page: warm, flat, editorial, and sparse. Once a visitor enters live festival work, the guide opens into a compact night-time instrument panel built from aubergine surfaces, cream text, bright signals, and the supplied festival artwork.

The system is practical, lively, and clear. Festival character comes from the rounded type, location-pin geometry, star-speckled atmosphere, and orange–cyan signal pair; it never outranks the map, the current state, or the next action. Density rises in operational views because the phone is a tool in motion, while setup uses larger grouped fields for deliberate administrative work.
keyCharacteristics: A purposeful light-to-dark context switch rather than one blended theme.
Rounded, heavy typography with compressed labels and decisive hierarchy.
Warm festival neutrals anchored by orange actions and cyan selection states.
Illustrated festival maps treated as primary product material, not decoration.
Compact controls, safe-area-aware shells, and visible live/stale state changes.

rules.name: The Context Switch Rule
rules.body: Field Paper and Field Ink own selection surfaces; Night Aubergine and Plum Panel own live tools. Do not merge them into a grey compromise.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Orange means action or owned attention, cyan means active selection or information, and green versus brown means freshness. Never swap these roles for variety.

rules.name: The One Rounded Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a fashionable display face or generic geometric sans; hierarchy comes from scale, weight, and tracking within the existing rounded system stack.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: Operational labels stay short and bold. Explanations use body text outside the control rather than shrinking a long sentence into it.

rules.name: The Map-First Rule
rules.body: In live operation, the festival artwork and people layer receive the largest continuous region. Controls wrap around the map rather than pushing it below an explanatory dashboard.

rules.name: The Contextual Lift Rule
rules.body: Light directory surfaces are flat; blur and shadow appear only where a night-time control must separate from live map content.

dos: Do preserve the explicit light index / dark operation split when adding a surface; choose its context instead of averaging both palettes.
Do keep the illustrated festival map visually dominant and align interface chrome around it.
Do use Campfire Orange, Signal Cyan, Live Green, and Stale Brown according to their established meanings.
Do use short Dutch labels, heavy control type, and safe-area-aware mobile spacing.
Do pair color state with text, shape, glow, saturation, or another non-color cue.
donts: Don't turn the light festival index into a stack of floating dark cards or add night-mode gradients to its Field Paper canvas.
Don't cover the festival map with explanatory panels when a compact badge, tooltip, or dock can carry the state.
Don't use orange, cyan, green, and brown interchangeably for decorative variety.
Don't introduce unrelated fonts, sharp enterprise controls, or generic blue-and-white SaaS styling.
Don't animate attention states without a reduced-motion fallback.
